model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the coverage achieved by four different models—Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT—as a function of the number of completions, denoted as k. The x-axis represents the “Number of completions (k)” on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2^20 to 2^25, with tick labels indicating powers of two and no explicit unit provided. The y-axis represents “Coverage,” scaled linearly from 0.4 to 0.8. The blue line with circular markers and solid style corresponds to Llama-3B, starting at a coverage of approximately 0.42 at k=2^20 and rising to about 0.84 at k=2^25. The green line with triangular markers and solid style represents Llama-3B + FT, beginning at roughly 0.42 at k=2^20 and increasing to approximately 0.85 at k=2^25. The light blue line with diamond markers and dashed style corresponds to Llama-1B, starting at a coverage of approximately 0.28 at k=2^20 and reaching about 0.83 at k=2^25. The light green line with inverted triangular markers and dashed style represents Llama-1B + FT, beginning at roughly 0.28 at k=2^20 and increasing to approximately 0.84 at k=2^25. All four lines show a general upward trend in coverage as k increases, with the Llama-3B variants achieving higher coverage than the Llama-1B variants across the entire range.
